Title: Sore Jaw Even When You Weren't Stressed? 3 Causes of Teeth Grinding

Description:
Waking up with a sore jaw and worn-down teeth, even on a night you weren't stressed at all? The real cause might not be stress - it could be acid reflux, genetics, or a medication you're already taking.

People with GERD are up to six times more likely to grind their teeth at night. Twin studies show genetics explains roughly half the risk of sleep bruxism. And stimulant medication for ADHD, like Adderall or Ritalin, can also ramp up jaw muscle activity.

Watch to see why each one matters, and what to do about it.
